bagua.page.intro:
§l1. What it is§r
The eight trigrams sit above the aspects: Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Gen and Kun. They are used for four things:
· once known, they can be combined at the research table;
· in infusion they are aspects in their own right, dozens of points each;
· §9§lrecipes also require the matching trigram stones under the base§r;
· wand rods and caps are graded by them.
This entry is the root of the whole tree: learn the trigrams first.
bagua.page.source_scan:
§l2. How to learn them§r
Three ways, pick any one; learning is permanent.
§l2.1 Scan (fastest)§r Use a Thaumometer on:
· Qian Daylight Detector
· Dui Golden Apple
· Li Firework Rocket
· Zhen Bell
· Xun Note Block
· Kan Seagrass
· Gen Blast Furnace
· Kun Hay Bale
bagua.page.source_fuse:
§l2.2 Combine at the research table§r Drag the two aspects that form the trigram into the rune circle and press the purple fuse button.

§l2.3 Boil out essentia§r Boil those eight items in a crucible for the matching essentia; beast ingots and xuanshu works carry trigram qi too. Every trigram aspect the xuanshu works need comes from here.
bagua.page.rule:
§lHow the trigrams are formed§r
Qian = Aer + Lux
Dui = Aqua + Metallum
Li = Ignis + Lux
Zhen = Aer + Tempestas
Xun = Aer + Arbor
Kan = Aqua + Tenebrae
Gen = Terra + Vinculum
Kun = Terra + Perditio

Aspect names are shown in Latin; go by the icon and the description.
bagua.page.terrain_all:
§l1. What it is§r
Each trigram gathers its qi in one kind of place; the pedestal reads exactly that.
A place may match several. The pedestal shows them all, but conversion follows the highest priority: Li > Kan > Gen > Xun > Dui > Zhen > Kun > Qian.
The next eight pages list the eight places.
bagua.page.assembly:
§l2. Requirements§r
· 1 rod, 2 identical caps, on a diagonal.
· The name is cap plus rod: the bagua cap on a sixiang rod makes the Bagua Sixiang Obsidian Wand.
· Stats: Vermilion 918 vis / 90% cost; Sixiang 1949 / 80%; Xuanshu 2035 / 60%.
· All three recharge passively from any essentia channel nearby, jars and tubes alike; no pedestal needed.
bagua.page.wand_assembly:
§l1. What it is§r
Put a rod and two identical caps together into one wand.
§l2. How§r In the Arcane Workbench, lay them on one diagonal: rod in the centre cell, the two caps top-right and bottom-left.
§8Diagram (柄 rod, 端 cap, · empty):§r
· · 端

端 · ·
§8A wand needs two identical caps: the two ends of a wand are one thing.§r
bagua.page.materials_b:
§lOther xuanshu curios§r
§lXuanshu Crystal Cluster§r bagua shard at the centre, one of each beast ingot, 4 xuanshu shards, 4 Salis Mundus, 6 of each trigram. Each symmetric pair around the matrix presses down one row of instability, and the block zeroes instability within twelve blocks.
§lAkashic Codex of Myriad Realms§r bagua shard at the centre, eight Xuanshu Bagua Salt, 20 of each trigram. Grants 1000 research points of every aspect.
§lGrand Scroll of Universal Instruction§r the codex at the centre, eight xuanshu ingots, 32 of each trigram. Completes every unfinished research entry (warp is settled as usual).

bagua.page.caps:
§lRoadmap§r
These entries are one chain, not a list:
Kan -> xuanshu ingot -> xuanshu shard -> cloth / rod / cap -> wand
Trigram stones are boiled out of the pedestal's gathered qi; they are a positional requirement for infusion.
The three machines and the charger form another chain; they handle production.
Foci, pick, hoe, purifying stone, arcane table and node modifier hang off the matching trigram.
When you are stuck, come back to this page and see which link is missing.
bagua.page.node_ingots:
§l1. What it is§r
The four beast ingots (Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise) are the middle tier: shards, infusion and caps all use them.
All four are made only in the Arcane Workbench, 100 of each primal aspect apiece.
The next four pages give the layouts.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:SHA: All that is left of a beast
bagua.page.node_shards:
§l1. What it is§r
Shards are the tier below the beast ingots, and most xuanshu recipes are counted in them: cloth, rods, caps, both tables, the foci.
Beast shards come from boiling the matching ingot; the xuanshu shard is a bagua shard boiled one step further.
Beast ingots and xuanshu shards also smelt, in the Infernal Furnace, into bagua shards and bagua salt.
bagua.page.node_cloths:
§l1. What it is§r
Cloth wraps the rod. Sixiang cloth is silver-white, xuanshu cloth black-gold; wrapped in it, a rod behaves.
Sixiang cloth goes on first, xuanshu cloth outside. Both are alchemy, not loom work.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:WAN: The rod holds, the cap spends
bagua.page.node_wands:
§l1. What it is§r
The rod is a wand's bone: it decides how much essentia the wand holds.
All three rods are infused; after that, two caps of the same kind go on one diagonal in the Arcane Workbench.
The three differ in one thing only: capacity and cost. One page each follows.
bagua.page.node_caps:
§l1. What it is§r
Caps sit on both ends and decide how fast essentia leaks when you cast: lower cost, less waste.
Assembly puts the rod in the middle and two identical caps top-right and bottom-left, so one wand needs two caps.
Three pages, one pair each.

block.skydeitymysticpivot.bagua_stone.lo: Trigram stone. Wherever it stands, its qi attunes to the land of that chunk (%s is its nature).
bagua.page.stones_what:
§1§l1. What it is§9§l
Trigram stones are not material but position: eight stones, one per trigram, set under the base so the fire will start.
How many and which ones is written on each recipe page. Miss one and the recipe is not consumed: a wisp of smoke, and the action bar names the missing trigram.
Every extra stone presses down 2 instability, counting at most three.§r
bagua.page.stones_recipe:
§1§l2. Requirements§9§l
Trigram stones are not boiled; the pedestal makes them:
1. the pedestal must be awakened and stand in the matching qi;
2. jars holding that trigram's essentia within 5x5;
3. one Sixiang Stone Brick on the pedestal top, only one at a time;
4. at 8 points of qi the brick becomes the stone. Take it, set the next.
Wrong qi or too little essentia: it simply waits, using nothing.§r
bagua.page.pedestal_altar:
§l1. What it is§r
The pedestal does three things:
· it reads the trigram qi under it;
· it draws essentia from nearby jars and keeps it;
· with a Sixiang brick on top and 8 points of the local qi, it turns the brick into a trigram stone.
Under open sky it also turns obsidian on its top slowly into crying obsidian.
An unawakened pedestal is just a block and does nothing.
bagua.page.pedestal_qi:
§l2. Requirements§r
· Pedestal block: Arcane Workbench (next pages).
· Four Sixiang Stone Bricks: crucible (next pages).
· Qi is only read after awakening, and it decides whether you can make stones at all.
· Essentia range: 5x5 horizontally, two blocks up and down; jars and reservoirs count.
· Closing the altar, or the qi changing, scatters what it gathered.
bagua.page.pedestal_lands:
§lWhere the qi is§r
§fQian§0 open sky, nothing overhead
§3Dui§0 swamps (mangrove included)
§4Li§0 the Nether's crimson and warped forests
§6Zhen§0 badlands
§2Xun§0 forests
§1Kan§0 warm oceans
§8Gen§0 mountains
§8Kun§0 deep earth, below layer 10
When several match, all are shown, but only the highest priority counts: Li, Kan, Gen, Xun, Dui, Zhen, Kun, Qian.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_crucib: Three chambers brew at once, drawing essentia from jars and tubes within 5x5x5.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_alchem: Automated essentia smelting: feed it items and it burns out their essentia by itself, then ships it to the tubes and jars around it.
bagua.page.machine_furnace:
§l1. What it is§r
Three chambers smelt in parallel; one piece of fuel drives all three; one batch per tick, up to 64 items.
Feed from the top, draw from the bottom; all six faces are configurable (right-click empty-handed for the transfer panel).
§5Special recipes§0: a beast ingot yields 2 bagua shards, a xuanshu shard yields 2 salt. No ordinary furnace can make them. Everything smelted here yields double.
bagua.page.machine_crucible:
§l1. What it is§r
A single-block improvement on the base crucible: no heat, no water, and no flux to worry about.
Three work faces can run three recipes at once; one batch per tick, up to 64 items; drop in the catalyst and it starts.
Essentia comes from tubes and jars within 5x5x5; it is itself a suction-128 endpoint, so adjacent tubes push to it.
bagua.page.machine_alchemy:
§l1. What it is§r
The exact opposite of the crucible: it burns items down into raw essentia.
Three chambers in parallel, one batch per tick, up to 64; essentia is sent to tubes and jars within 5x5x3.
Right-click empty-handed for the transfer panel; each of six faces can be off or auto-input.
§8The crucible draws essentia to make items; this one burns items to make essentia. Put them together with a length of tube and you have a line.§r

bagua.page.machine_furnace2:
§l3. Origin§r
A single-block version of the infernal furnace: the tower is gone, only the hottest part of the fire is left.
The walls are nether brick and the firelight bleeds through; from a distance it looks like a burning coal.
§8Three chambers share one mouth, which is why one piece of fuel smelts three stacks. That is where the saving is.§r
bagua.page.machine_crucible2:
§l3. Origin§r
The base crucible wants fire and water and still threatens to spill flux everywhere. This one drops all three: the catalyst is the invitation, and the essentia finds its own way in.
The rim is a machined throat, with a lens in front so you can see what is inside.
§8They say the lens is for whatever is in the pot: it should know who is boiling it.§r
bagua.page.machine_alchemy2:
§l3. Origin§r
The eldest of the three. It wants fire, so its body is shaped like the infernal furnace; what it yields is qi, not goods, so it has no output face.
The essentia needs someone to collect it; if nobody does, it goes looking for the nearest tube.
§8An old smith says it has a steward's temper: if you will not take it, it keeps tidying for you.§r
bagua.page.charger_intro:
§l1. What it is§r
Stand it directly under an aura node and give it redstone:
· after ten seconds the node becomes a charged node, drawing at most 40 points from it in all;
· it does not stop there: the node's per-aspect caps climb over time, up to 64 per tick of output;
· cut the redstone and the node drifts back to its old state.
§8It only reads the cell directly above: no node there, and it is an ornament.§r
§cWarning: breaking the charger after charging makes the node explode, exactly as breaking a base-mod assembly would.§r
bagua.page.charger_intro2:
§l3. Origin§r
The base mod wants three machines in a ring to do this; here it is pressed into one cell: a three-legged cauldron with a star flame in its belly, and the transducer sitting on that flame.
The two advanced stabilisers on its feet are not decoration: the node has to be clamped the way they would clamp it before charging means anything.
§8Three machines make things; this one feeds a node. With it, the other branch of the line is complete.§r

bagua.page.purify_intro:
§l1. What it is§r
Standing in tainted ground it sweeps every two seconds:
· tainted blocks revert to dirt and grass, tainted and eerie biomes revert with them;
· nearby flux goo is eaten;
· players standing inside have permanent and sticky warp cleared, and taint's lingering effects pulled out.
Standing alone it covers the chunk it is in.

block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_purify: Ring it 3x3 with one of each of the eight trigram stones, then right-click the centre with a wand: all nine take altar shape at once, and the range grows to the nine chunks around it.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_charge: Set directly below an aura node and power it with redstone: within ten seconds the node is energized.
Faster and cheaper than the vanilla three-block assembly - ten seconds, and at most forty points drawn from the node.
Once charged, the node's per-aspect caps keep rising over time (one step per second), lifting its per-tick output up to 64/t; cut the redstone and the node slowly reverts.

bagua.page.purify_array2:
§lLaying it out§r
All nine on one ground layer: the stone in the middle, a trigram stone on each of the eight cells around it. All eight kinds present is enough; which cell holds which trigram does not matter.
Trigram stones can be picked up and set elsewhere; they are not consumed.
bagua.page.purify_array3:
§lStarting it§r
The array does not start by itself; it is off by default. §lRight-click the central stone with a wand and it rises§r: all nine reshape at once into a blue-gold altar.
Right-click again to close it; dig out any outer stone and it falls apart on its own.
Once formed, the reach goes from one chunk to the 3x3 of chunks around it.

1. find flat ground, put the pedestal in the middle;
2. lay a 3x3 around it: one Sixiang Stone Brick in each of the four corners, leave the other four cells empty;
3. with all four set, §lright-click the pedestal with a wand to awaken it§r; sneak-right-click to close it.

Once awake the four bricks tilt up in gold toward the pedestal; you can see at a glance.
bagua.page.pedestal_essentia:
§lDrawing essentia§r
It only draws when the top is set up properly; otherwise it does not move at all and will not drain your jars.
Jars only pass essentia through their top face, but a jar lying on its side or upside down is still drawn from.
You can see a thread of essentia run from the jar into the pedestal, the same as at an infusion altar.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:XUA: Pick, axe and shovel in one
bagua.page.pickaxe2_intro:
§l1. What it is§r
One tool that acts as pick, axe and shovel.
· Stone, wood and dirt all mine at full speed: 52000 durability, speed 40, attack +6, enchantability 25, tier of netherite.
· Comes with Fortune XVI built in; ore drops roll at level 16.
· Sneak-right-click toggles tunnel / single mode; the action bar reports which.
§8It fells and shovels, but it will not strip logs or make paths for you.§r
bagua.page.pickaxe2_tunnel:
§l2. The two modes§r
§lSingle§r ordinary mining: one block in, one block out.
§lTunnel§r after the first block it keeps going 16 blocks along the horizontal direction you face. Face south and you get a 16-block tunnel.
Air and fluids are passed through; a block entity (chest, machine) or an unbreakable block (bedrock, barrier) stops it in front.
§8Every tunnel block drops and costs durability as usual. The mode stays with the pick through hands and chests.§r
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_pickaxe:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion upgrade (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Bagua Pickaxe
· eight cells: 4 xuanshu shards, 4 xuanshu ingots (interleaved)
· aspects: 64 terra, 64 ordo, 48 each aer, ignis, aqua, perditio, plus 32 of each trigram
· instability: 6
· §9§lstones: Qian, Kan, Dui under the base in 5x5§r
§cInfusion does not keep the centre tool's enchantments: enchant it first.§r
bagua.page.hoe_intro:
§l1. What it is§r
A hoe that tends a whole field.
· Right-click: till a 9x9 around the block into farmland (grass, dirt, coarse dirt, path, rooted dirt; cells with something above are skipped). One durability for the lot.
· Sneak-right-click: place a water source above the clicked block.
· Held in the main hand: pushes unripe crops within 9x9 up one stage every second; stems, sugarcane, bamboo and saplings get a bone-meal tick.
§8It ignores light and water: no water in the field, no light in the cave, they still grow.§r
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_hoe:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion upgrade (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Bagua Pickaxe
· eight cells: 4 xuanshu shards, 2 xuanshu ingots, 1 diamond hoe (interleaved)
· aspects: 64 terra, 48 aqua, 48 ordo, 32 each aer, ignis, perditio, plus 32 of each trigram
· instability: 6
· §9§lstones: Qian, Kan, Dui under the base in 5x5§r
§cThe centre tool's enchantments are not kept either.§r
item.skydeitymysticpivot.teaching_scroll: Unlocks (completes) every research entry at once
message.skydeitymysticpivot.teaching_scr: Every research entry is already complete - keeping the scroll
item.skydeitymysticpivot.disenchant_book: Craft with a single enchanted item: every enchantment on it is copied onto an enchanted book.
The item loses all its enchantments, but is returned intact otherwise (durability, name, components).
item.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_void_ey: Worn in the ring slot: reveals aura nodes and container aspects, like the Goggles of Revealing
bagua.page.pickaxe2_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The plume phoenix is a bird in the xuanshu furnace that will not land. Take its plume, borrow the sky-scorching fire, and put it in with the pick; three days without letting the fire die, and the pick is done.
Carry it into the mountains and the stone opens; hold it over a gorge and the water runs backwards.
§8They say this was never meant to be made by hands, and that heaven borrowed a pair.§r
bagua.page.hoe_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Xuanming is the water god of the north, who holds one sea. When this hoe was cast, a layer of northern sea essence was laid in the furnace floor first, so the shaft stays cool and your palm sweats water after holding it a while.
Swing it and the soil steps aside; lift it and the seedlings climb.
§8Someone asked why it is called sea-calming: water carries boats and swallows them, and the water in a field is no different.§r
bagua.recipe.focus_guardian:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Totem of Undying
· eight cells: 4 quicksilver, 4 glowstone dust, 2 Salis Mundus, 2 enchanted cloth
· aspects: 64 of each trigram
· instability: 6
· §9§lstones: one Gen stone under the base.§r
bagua.page.focus_guardian_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Qian is heaven, pure yang hardness. Gang qi is the qi of the outer heaven: colourless, formless, and it stops blades.
Old cultivators spent a lifetime forging one ward of gang qi about themselves, and no weapon touched them; here a totem serves as the lure and the trigram qi as the furnace, and the ward is sealed into a focus.
§8The Daoists say Qian Yuan is heaven's first qi. With this focus you wear the sky.§r
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:FOC: Mark once, return at a thought
bagua.recipe.focus_teleport:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Primordial Pearl
· eight cells: one shard of each of the six (aer, ignis, aqua, terra, ordo, perditio)
· aspects: 64 of each trigram
· instability: 6
· §9§lstones: one Gen stone under the base.§r
bagua.page.focus_teleport_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The crimson plume is the bird's; the bird rules the south and fire, and its wings scorch ten thousand li. The old books speak of folding the ground into an inch, and of the bird crossing a thousand li in a wingbeat.
This focus takes the pearl as its heart and catches that one instant of burning sky: it is not flight, it is an instant. Mark a place, and no mountain or sea stands between.
§8If the landing is blocked it looks upward for somewhere to stand; if there is none, it does not move at all.§r
bagua.recipe.focus_cosmos:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Primordial Pearl
· eight cells: one shard of each of the six
· aspects: 64 of each trigram
· instability: 6
· §9§lstones: one Gen stone under the base.§r
bagua.page.focus_cosmos_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The green peak is a mountain, and a mountain is the hardest thing to move. The word for warding a prison names the killing air that guards the underworld gates: open them, and ten thousand peaks must fall apart.
This focus takes the pearl as its heart and forges the single word break into it: no chisel, no blast, no melt, just a point, and stone lets go.
§8They say its bearer points at nothing and nothing remains, which is why it is also called the pointing that topples mountains.§r
gui.skydeitymysticpivot.node_modifier.hi: Right-click with a wand to run
message.skydeitymysticpivot.node_modifie: There is no node in a jar above the censer; it cannot run.
The bloom slot needs one vial of Celestial Bloom to know which aspects to infuse.
The ingot slot needs one xuanshu ingot.
gui.skydeitymysticpivot.arcane_table.hin: Right-click with a wand to run
message.skydeitymysticpivot.arcane_table: There is nothing on the table.
That item carries no enchantment to raise.
Every enchantment is already at its peak (128).
The dye slot needs one xuanshu ingot.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_spirit: A jade heart born of infusion. Both the Arcane Table and the Infusion Table are built upon it.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_node_m: Right-click with a wand: infuses aspects into the node above - the six primals first, then random draws.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_arcane: Right-click with a wand: spend an ingot and six primals to raise every enchantment on the item by one.
item.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_void_ey: Slowly recharges every wand in your inventory (1% of each channel every two seconds)
bagua.page.focus_guardian_func:
§l1. What it is§r
Set in a wand, right-click: 200 of each primal aspect gives you a guardian heart circling you.
On death it takes one lethal blow for you, then is spent. No duration; it stacks.
§8It hurts nothing and drives nothing off. It only holds, for that one instant.§r
bagua.page.focus_teleport_func:
§l1. What it is§r
Set in a wand:
· Sneak-right-click: record the coordinates under your feet into the wand (dimension included), no cost.
· Right-click: 10 of each primal aspect, and you are back at that point.
If the spot is blocked it searches up to 4 blocks upward; if it finds nothing you stay put.
bagua.page.focus_cosmos_func:
§l1. What it is§r
Set in a wand, right-click a block: 10 of each primal aspect and the block itself drops as an item.
Hardness and tier are ignored; even bedrock goes.
§8It does not fire block-break events, and containers do not spill.§r
bagua.page.bagua_pickaxe_func:
§l1. What it is§r
A pickaxe.
· 52000 durability, mining speed 40, same tier as diamond.
· Stone only: stone, ores, deepslate, at full speed, normal drops.
· It does not fell trees and does not shovel dirt.
It is the first pick of the line; both the Plume-Phoenix and the Nether-Calm hoe are infused up from it.
bagua.page.bagua_pickaxe_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
When it was cast there was no phoenix and no northern sea, only a pot of bagua shards and three thaumium ingots. The furnace master said the head must pass through the heart of a mountain, or it was no tool.
So they took Qian for metal, Kan for danger, Dui for the marsh: metal is the tool, danger is the ground, the marsh is what softens. Three trigrams together, and the mountain gave way.
§8Both later picks grew out of this one.§r
bagua.page.purify_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Jade grows in rotten soil. A smith buried a xuanshu ingot in the worst taint he could find and dug it out forty-nine days later, white veins all over it; three stones, Kun, Zhen and Gen, held the veins still.
Wherever it stands since, the taint there gives up one step.
§8Someone calls it feeding jade on poison. The smith does not deny it: a thing that never sat in rot cannot wash rot off anyone else.§r
bagua.gua.qian.terrain:
§lQian, where the qi is§r
Under §fopen sky§0: nothing overhead.
Whether on a peak or a plain, look up and see sky.
§8The pedestal must stand here to read this trigram.§r
bagua.gua.dui.terrain:
§lDui, where the qi is§r
In §3swamps§0 (mangrove swamps count).
§8/locate biome minecraft:swamp finds one.§r
bagua.gua.li.terrain:
§lLi, where the qi is§r
In the Nether's §4crimson§0 and §5warped§0 forests.
§8The hottest place in the world is a rainforest on fire.§r
bagua.gua.zhen.terrain:
§lZhen, where the qi is§r
In §6badlands§0 (mesa).
§8/locate biome minecraft:badlands finds one.§r
bagua.gua.xun.terrain:
§lXun, where the qi is§r
In §2forests§0, any forest biome.
§8/locate biome minecraft:forest finds one.§r
bagua.gua.kan.terrain:
§lKan, where the qi is§r
In §1warm oceans§0.
§8An ordinary ocean does not count; it must be warm.§r
bagua.gua.gen.terrain:
§lGen, where the qi is§r
In §8mountains§0: windswept hills, jagged peaks and the like.
§8Stand on a ridge and the qi is under your feet.§r
bagua.gua.kun.terrain:
§lKun, where the qi is§r
In §8deep earth§0 below layer ten (Y<10).
§8Dig down; the deeper, the purer.§r
bagua.page.spirit_core:
§l1. What it is§r
It does nothing on its own; it serves as the centre of the Arcane Table and the Node Modifier, and both infusions start from it.
Green jade for the body, gilt for the veins, trigram qi sealed inside.
§8On a table top it looks like a jade heart, breathing.§r
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_spirit_core:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Xuanshu Ingot
· eight cells: 2 xuanshu cloth, one of each beast ingot, 2 bagua salt, 2 xuanshu shards, 2 glowstone dust
· aspects: 16 of each trigram (no primal aspects)
· instability: 8
· §9§lstones: Kan, Xun, Gen under the base.§r
bagua.page.spirit_core_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The xuanshu line builds the heart before the machine. A smith wrapped an ingot in two layers of xuanshu cloth, pressed it with the four beast ingots to the four directions, and sealed the mouth with bagua salt. In the furnace the salt melted, the cloth charred, and only the jade heart was left, beating in the fire.
When the fire died it was still beating.
§8Afterwards the Arcane Table and the Node Modifier were only ways of giving that heart hands and eyes.§r
bagua.page.arcane_table:
§l1. What it is§r
Put the item to be raised on the top and one xuanshu ingot in the dye slot; §lright-click with a wand§r and every enchantment on it goes up one level, capped at 128.
The wand pays 129 of each of the six primal aspects.
§8No enchantment, no ingot, or already capped: it only prints a line and touches nothing.§r
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_arcane_table:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Xuanshu Spirit Core
· eight cells: 2 xuanshu ingots, one of each beast ingot, 2 bagua salt, 2 primal mana, 2 disenchanting books
· aspects: 32 of each primal, 48 ordo, 48 terra, plus 24 each of Li, Dui, Qian
· instability: 8
· §9§lstones: Kan, Xun, Gen under the base.§r
bagua.page.arcane_table_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The enchanting table is dead: it only copies the words in the shelves onto a sword. The arcane table is alive: it draws the qi out of a wand and pours it into every enchantment already there.
The top is shaped like the old table, only the book in the middle has been replaced by a jade heart that beats.
§8Someone says this is not enchanting but feeding.§r
bagua.page.node_modifier:
§l1. What it is§r
It adds an aspect to an aura node:
· put the jarred node directly above the table;
· put one ethereal bloom and one xuanshu ingot in the interface;
· §lright-click with a wand§r and the node gains one aspect.
§8It fills the six basics first; once those are in, it draws from the rest.§r
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_node_modifier:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Xuanshu Spirit Core
· eight cells: 1 xuanshu ingot, one of each beast ingot, 1 xuanshu shard, 2 primal mana, 1 Motus Ignis, 1 primal focus, 1 advanced node stabiliser, 1 essentia reservoir
· aspects: 32 of each primal, 48 aer, plus 24 each of Li, Dui, Qian
· instability: 8
· §9§lstones: Kan, Xun, Gen under the base.§r
bagua.page.node_modifier_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
A node is something the world grows by itself, and hands are not supposed to touch it. The xuanshu line does not accept that: they turned a censer into a table, used ethereal bloom as the lure, and forced an aspect into a node.
If it goes in, the node acknowledges you; if not, it simply ignores you.
§8The top is jade because jade has no ambitions: it only lets qi pass.§r
bagua.gua.qian:
§l1. What it is§r
Qian = Aer + Lux, three yang lines, the sky, gilded.
It is spent as an aspect in infusion, and §9§lsome recipes want a Qian stone under the base§r.
Recipes needing a Qian stone: Bagua Pickaxe, Plume-Phoenix Pickaxe, Nether-Calm Hoe, Cosmic Cap, Silverwood Rod, Xuanshu Charger.
bagua.gua.dui:
§l1. What it is§r
Dui = Aqua + Metallum, one yin over two yang, the marsh, silver.
An aspect in infusion; recipes needing a Dui stone: Bagua Pickaxe, Plume-Phoenix Pickaxe, Nether-Calm Hoe, Arcane Table, Node Modifier.
bagua.gua.li:
§l1. What it is§r
Li = Ignis + Lux, yang outside and yin within, fire, vermilion.
An aspect in infusion; recipes needing a Li stone: Sixiang Rod, Sixiang Cap, Vermilion Rod, Vermilion Cap, Arcane Table, Node Modifier.
bagua.gua.zhen:
§l1. What it is§r
Zhen = Aer + Tempestas, yang below two yin, thunder, blue-green.
An aspect in infusion; the recipe needing a Zhen stone: the Purifying Stone.
bagua.gua.xun:
§l1. What it is§r
Xun = Aer + Arbor, yin below two yang, wind and wood, blue-grey.
An aspect in infusion; recipes needing a Xun stone: Infernal Furnace, Crucible, Alchemy Furnace, Charger, Spirit Core, Arcane Table, Node Modifier.
bagua.gua.kan:
§l1. What it is§r
Kan = Aqua + Tenebrae, yang within and yin outside, water, indigo.
An aspect in infusion; recipes needing a Kan stone: Spirit Core, Arcane Table, Node Modifier, Charger, Bagua Pickaxe, Plume-Phoenix Pickaxe, Nether-Calm Hoe.
bagua.gua.gen:
§l1. What it is§r
Gen = Terra + Vinculum, yang over two yin, mountain, stone-brown.
An aspect in infusion; recipes needing a Gen stone: Sixiang Rod, Sixiang Cap, Vermilion Rod, Vermilion Cap, all three foci, Purifying Stone, Spirit Core, Arcane Table, Node Modifier.
bagua.gua.kun:
§l1. What it is§r
Kun = Terra + Perditio, three yin lines, the earth, ochre.
An aspect in infusion; recipes needing a Kun stone: Sixiang Rod, Sixiang Cap, Purifying Stone.
bagua.gua.qian.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Daylight Detector.
· Research table: Aer + Lux.
· Crucible: boil a Daylight Detector for Qian essentia.
§8Qian qi gathers under open sky.§r
bagua.gua.dui.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Golden Apple.
· Research table: Aqua + Metallum.
· Crucible: boil a Golden Apple.
§8Dui qi gathers in swamps, mangrove swamps included.§r
bagua.gua.li.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Firework Rocket.
· Research table: Ignis + Lux.
· Crucible: boil a Firework Rocket.
§8Li qi gathers in the Nether's crimson and warped forests.§r
bagua.gua.zhen.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Bell.
· Research table: Aer + Tempestas.
· Crucible: boil a Bell.
§8Zhen qi gathers in badlands.§r
bagua.gua.xun.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Note Block.
· Research table: Aer + Arbor.
· Crucible: boil a Note Block.
§8Xun qi gathers in forests.§r
bagua.gua.kan.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Seagrass.
· Research table: Aqua + Tenebrae.
· Crucible: boil Seagrass.
§8Kan qi gathers in warm oceans.§r
bagua.gua.gen.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Blast Furnace.
· Research table: Terra + Vinculum.
· Crucible: boil a Blast Furnace.
§8Gen qi gathers in mountains.§r
bagua.gua.kun.scan:
§l2. How to get it§r
· Scan: Hay Bale.
· Research table: Terra + Perditio.
· Crucible: boil a Hay Bale.
§8Kun qi gathers below Y=10.§r
message.skydeitymysticpivot.star_dial.in: Twelve dials must be laid out in a 3x4 grid.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:XUA: A door forced into a node
message.skydeitymysticpivot.star_gate_na: The stars are not aligned: put one xuanshu ingot on each of the five Southern stars (Tianfu, Tianliang, Tianji, Tiantong, Tianxiang).
bagua.page.star_craft_board:
§1§l1. What it is§9§l
The star dial array is a switch: once the array is formed and its seats are fed, a machine's overhead line lights; only then will it work. Otherwise it says the stars are not aligned.
§1§l2. How to build it§9§l
Twelve dials laid as one slab: three across, four rows, touching, no gaps; the structure is drawn on the next page. One step is still missing: it has to be struck once before it becomes an array, see the page after that.§r
bagua.page.star_craft_machines:
§1§l2. Where machines go§9§l
In the ring hugging the outside of the array: extend it to 5 columns by 6 rows, and the outermost ring is where machines belong.
§1§lDiagram (盘 dial, 机 machine cell):§9§l
机 机 机 机 机
机 盘 盘 盘 机
机 盘 盘 盘 机
机 盘 盘 盘 机
机 盘 盘 盘 机
机 机 机 机 机§r
bagua.page.star_craft_use:
§1§l3. Seat requirements§9§l
Machines will not run away from the array; the seats supply the condition (seated items are only held there, never consumed):
§c§lRed§9§l Infernal Furnace: one §1§lxuanshu ingot§9§l on each of Tianshu, Tianxuan, Tianji, Tianquan; smelting doubles.
§a§lGreen§9§l Crucible: one §1§lxuanshu shard§9§l on each of the seven northern seats (Tianshu, Tianxuan, Tianji, Tianquan, Yuheng, Kaiyang, Yaoguang); only then is an unfired ingot refined into a xuanshu ingot.
§6§lGold§9§l Arcane Table and Node Modifier: one §1§lxuanshu ingot§9§l on each of the five southern stars (Tianfu, Tianliang, Tianji, Tiantong, Tianxiang); only then will they work.
§b§lTeal§9§l Replicator: one §1§ldragon egg§9§l on each of the six southern stars (Tianfu, Tianliang, Tianji, Tiantong, Tianxiang, Qisha); only then does it replicate.
One dial shows one dipper at a time: flip to the northern face to refine ingots, to the southern face to run the two tables or the replicator; sneak-right-click empty-handed to flip.§r
bagua.page.star_gate_tables:
§l3. Running condition§r
Neither table runs away from the array:
· put it in the 5x6 ring of the array;
· flip the dial to §bthe southern dipper§r and put one §lxuanshu ingot§r on each of §bTianfu, Tianliang, Tianji, Tiantong, Tianxiang§r;
· a §6golden§r line overhead means the condition is met; without it, it only says the stars are not aligned.
§8The Qisha seat can be left empty.§r
bagua.page.unfired_ingot:
§l1. What it is§r
The unfired ingot is a half-made thing: the star inside is dark and it does not know you yet.
It cannot be infused directly: it must pass the crucible first.
The finished xuanshu ingot is the backbone of the line: cloth, rods, caps, both tables and the foci all want it.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:XUA: Seven stars lit, and it lives
bagua.page.forged_ingot:
§l1. What it is§r
The xuanshu ingot is the core material, carrying trigram qi.
Cloth, rods, caps, both tables, the foci: all of them use it. In infusion it is both material and source of qi.
bagua.page.forged_ingot_recipe:
§l2. Requirements§r
Boiling (recipe on the previous page):
· in the pot: 1 unfired ingot
· aspects: 4 of each of the eight trigrams
· condition: one §lxuanshu shard§r on each of the seven northern seats; a green line overhead confirms it
§8The crucible must sit in the 5x6 ring of the star array; see the star array entry.§r
bagua.page.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The base mod splits everything into dozens of aspects: easy to memorise, impossible to order.
The xuanshu line says there is a layer under the aspects: eight boxes you can count on one hand.
Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Gen, Kun were divination words once; this line borrowed them as a filing system. People laughed. But in all the years since, not one infusion laid out by those eight boxes has blown up.
Whether the trigrams came first, or the explosions, nobody can say.
bagua.gua.qian.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Three yang lines: the fullest box of the eight. The sky is overhead, one glance away, which makes it the easiest trigram to learn.
The smiths chose it for the pick for a very practical reason: a pick that opens mountains should greet the sky first.
bagua.gua.dui.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
A marsh is water that stops in the low places and refuses to leave. The old books gloss Dui as joy: to open your mouth, to profit together.
So it is paired with metal. Metal cuts, and metal makes tools; to profit anyone, you first need a good blade.
bagua.gua.li.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Fire only burns by clinging to something; light is the reason it clings. The character li means exactly that: to attach.
Every furnace, lamp and star of the xuanshu line has a Li stone set under it first.
bagua.gua.zhen.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Thunder is a single instant: fast in, fast out, leaving only the noise.
The purifying stone wants Zhen for exactly that: taint does not seep away, it is struck apart.
bagua.gua.xun.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Wind gets in everywhere; wood grows along its grain. Xun is the most penetrating box of the eight.
All three machines want it, and the reason is plain: essentia must travel pipes, and pipes must follow the grain.
bagua.gua.kan.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Water keeps to the low places; where light never reaches is what Kan means. The old books call it danger, and nobody liked it.
Yet every xuanshu machine has a Kan stone pressed under it: only in dangerous ground does the work show.
bagua.gua.gen.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
A mountain is the art of not moving; the character gen means to stop.
A ward, a teleport and a stone-splitting focus look unrelated, but all three need the same thing: knowing when to stop. Only then can you guard, land, or break.
bagua.gua.kun.lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Three yin lines: the emptiest box of the eight. Empty is not nothing; empty can hold.
The deepest earth is below layer ten, where nothing grows, and where every ore waits.
bagua.page.terrain_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
This map does not look deduced; it looks tried. Old smiths carried pedestals across the world and marked a dot wherever one lit up.
After a few decades the eight places were complete. The map has no mountains and no rivers on it, only eight colours.
Someone asked why a warm ocean counts as Kan and an ordinary one does not. Nobody could answer; they only knew that in the next sea over, the pedestal stayed dark.
bagua.page.stones_lore:
§1§l3. Origin§9§l
There were no trigram stones at first, only pots of boiled stone, and too many blown furnaces. Then a smith understood: the fire would not start because the position was wrong, not the materials.
So the stones came: nothing burns, they only stand. Stand right, and the furnace opens by itself.
Smiths still walk once around the base before setting stones. Not a rule, just a habit.§r
bagua.page.pedestal_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The pedestal began as an infusion altar's foot; the smiths thought it only held up the scenery, so they opened a hole in it.
With the hole open the qi walks in by itself, and when it is full the stone on top changes its temper.
One old smith insists it was not their doing: the pedestal simply wanted a use.
bagua.page.star_craft_lore:
§1§l3. Origin§9§l
The dials were made for reading the sky; the smiths turned them over, laid them on the ground, and they became an array.
Twelve faces, each with a line of characters; only all twelve make a whole sky. Someone once tried eleven, and the machine stayed silent. The smith only said: if the sky is short a star, is it still the sky?
Nobody has left one out since.§r
bagua.page.unfired_req:
§l2. Requirements§r
In the Arcane Workbench (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Nether Star
· corners: 2 Xuanshu Bagua Salt, 2 Xuanshu Cloth (interleaved)
· the rest: one of each beast ingot
· aspects: 77 of each primal
It comes out cold. To make anything of it, it still has to face the crucible.
bagua.page.unfired_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The ingot is cold when it comes out. A smith turns it over and looks: the star is inside, dark, like an eye not yet open.
Some think that means it is done, take it to infuse, and waste a whole batch.
§8"The star is dark. It does not know you yet."§r
bagua.page.forged_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
When the seven stars light, the ingot comes alive: the stars float up, blue, red, white and black run together, and nobody can say what colour it is.
The smiths call it lighting the star, and it can only be done three times; a fourth and the ingot comes apart.
Why seven and not eight, nobody has asked. Asking would get no answer anyway.
bagua.page.ingot_req:
§l2. Layout (3x3)§r
· centre: Mystic Ingot
· four corners: one Salis Mundus each (four in all)
· bottom middle: Diamond
· top middle and both middle sides: one item per beast
§8Diagram (材 top-middle item, 灵 side items):§r
材 盐 材
灵 神秘锭 灵
盐 钻石 盐
§8Four corners means four salt, not two.§r
bagua.page.recipe_ingot_note:
§lWhat each beast takes§r
Azure Dragon End Crystal on top, Dragon's Breath at the sides
Vermilion Bird Blaze Powder on top, Glowstone Dust at the sides
White Tiger Calcite on top, Quicksilver at the sides
Black Tortoise Turtle Scute on top, Prismarine Shards at the sides
100 of each primal aspect, all four alike.
bagua.page.ingots_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The four ingots are not four metals but four directions: dragon east, bird south, tiger west, tortoise north. Only together do they make one square map.
The smiths do not watch the fire when casting; they watch the compass. Dragon in the east wind, bird under the harshest sun.
§8An apprentice once cast a bird ingot on a cloudy day. It came out grey. The old smith said nothing, and put it in a cupboard.§r
bagua.page.shards_req:
§l2. Requirements§r
· Crucible: one ingot + 2 of each trigram aspect gives the beast's shard.
· Xuanshu shard: one bagua shard + 4 of each trigram.
· Furnace: one beast ingot gives 2 bagua shards; one xuanshu shard gives 2 salt.
§cOnly the Infernal Furnace can make these; an ordinary furnace cannot.§r
The next ten pages are five boiling and five smelting recipes.
bagua.page.shards_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
The smiths will not say how a shard is broken, only that no beast was killed: it was taken apart.
The ingot scatters into trigram qi in the pot, and gathers again as it cools, but never into an ingot again. What comes back is too small to hold a whole beast, so it is called a shard.
§8The xuanshu shard is not a beast's: it is a bagua shard boiled once more, which is why it sits a tier higher and costs more.§r
bagua.page.cloths_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
Cloth is not woven but boiled: drop the material into the crucible and the trigram qi braids itself into warp and weft.
It keeps the qi it was boiled in, so sixiang cloth is cool and xuanshu cloth warm; you can tell them apart by touch.
§8An old tailor says he cannot sew this cloth. That is the furnace's job.§r
bagua.page.wands_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
A rod is a piece of a tree's bone. Silverwood carries vis best, obsidian is the proudest, grand wood is the cheapest and the most obedient.
A smith will tell you the price of the wood does not matter; what matters is whether it is willing to keep the qi inside itself.
§8Which is why the vermilion wand is the cheapest and the one most people carry first.§r
bagua.page.caps_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
A pair of caps is a pair of sheaths. When a smith beats one out, he does not ask how hard it should be, only how fine it should cut the flow.
Cut fine and the qi runs slow, and one wand lasts many more casts; cut too fine and the qi will not come out at all. That judgement lives in the hands.
§8The pair made from a dragon egg is said to be fine enough that you can hear the qi walking inside.§r
bagua.page.wand_assembly_lore:
§l3. Origin§r
A wand is not a weapon; it is a length of held pipe. The rod sets the capacity, the caps set the leak: two things that must add up.
An old smith assembles without looking at the recipe, only at whether the two ends answer each other: head and tail, same kind, same stock.
§8Someone asked whether one cosmic cap and one vermilion would do. The smith shook his head: that is a pipe with two ends fighting.§r
bagua.page.star_craft_activate:
§1§lForming it§9§l
§1§lRight-click any one dial with a wand and all twelve light; the array is made§9§l.
Sneak + wand takes it down again; break any one dial and the other eleven revert on their own, spilling whatever they held.
No need to aim: the array finds north itself. §1§lA dial drops only when mined with a pickaxe.§9§l§r
